modelDownload.readySubtitle: The Formula assistant is ready to use. Your spreadsheets stay on this computer.
modelDownload.oneTimeSubtitle: This is a one-time download. The AI model runs entirely on your device.
modelDownload.sha256Check: Checking that the file is complete…
modelDownload.loadFailed: The file is downloaded, but the Formula assistant couldn't start. Built-in checks are not affected and work as usual.
modelDownload.optionalSubtitle: The Formula assistant double-checks formula findings on this computer to cut down false alarms. It's optional: every built-in check works without it. Size: {{size}}. Download it once; after that it works offline.
modelDownload.importRequirement: If you already have the model file, you can import it. It must be named {{filename}} and be {{size}}. The app checks that the file is complete.
modelDownload.importWrongFile: This isn't the right file: its size or content doesn't match the Formula assistant. Make sure the download finished and the file name is right.

access_denied.title: Automatic download needs authorized access
access_denied.body: The download source refused the request, and retrying won't change that. You can keep using the built-in checks or import a model file you already downloaded.

source_unavailable.title: Automatic download source is unavailable
source_unavailable.body: The download source is unavailable right now and may be access-restricted. Try again later, or keep using the built-in checks and import a model file you already downloaded.

other.title: Automatic download did not finish
other.body: Check your internet connection and free disk space, then try again. You can also keep using the built-in checks or import a model file you already downloaded.

not_configured.title: Official download is not available
not_configured.body: An official download is not available yet. You can import a model file you are authorized to use; built-in checks remain available.

modelDownload.notConfigured: An official download is not available yet.
modelDownload.localSetupSubtitle: The Formula assistant reviews formula findings on this computer to reduce false alarms. Every built-in check works without it. Model file: {{size}}; works offline after setup.
